title: cli.channel_listener.ChannelAcceptOutcome
description:
The daemon's answer to one `POST /channels/{id}/accept`. Carries
NO secret — on success the owner secret arrives over the SSE.

anyOf.title: Accepted
anyOf.description:
The offer was accepted: the owner secret is being delivered
over this connection's SSE, and the publisher's command
unblocks.

anyOf.title: AlreadyAccepted
anyOf.description: The offer was already accepted by someone else.

anyOf.title: NotFound
anyOf.description: No open offer with that channel id.

anyOf.title: UnknownConnection
anyOf.description: The presented `S_conn` maps to no live connection.
